title: Tiangong Kaiwu (The Exploitation of the Works of Nature)
summary: Song Yingxing, an instructor in Fenyi County, Jiangxi, researched farming and craft technology and organised it into the Tiangong kaiwu, published in 1637 with funding from his friend Tu Shaokui. Its 121 illustrations accompany descriptions of over 130 types of productive technology and tools. It appeared only seven years before the Ming dynasty fell.

uncertainty.note: Publication year; the book was written over the preceding period.
